name: adapt-grow-reflection-module
description: A composed reflection activity: a lined sketchbook journal paired with a 'change the lens' panel of reframing prompts. Writing persists to suspend_data; never scored.

extra.info: Two-column reflection activity — a ruled sketchbook journal (auto-grows, saves to suspend_data, screen-reader friendly) beside a reframing 'change the lens' prompt panel. Collapses to one column on narrow screens and repaints with the active GROW theme.
